title: Elodie and the Safehouse
author: Juniper Amberdale
blurb: Bram Sterling, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, has spent three years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must burn the network that did the training, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
